summary: Defines the IBM Extended BCD Interchange Code (EBCDIC) and its mapping to ASCII so that every ARPANET host translates between the two in the same way. It describes the 8-bit EBCDIC character set and the extra characters needed.

eli5.summary: Two computers use different alphabets, so this note is a translation chart. Everyone follows the same chart so letters stay the same.
